summary: Frontend regression test of PERF-004 refactor (Find & Replace debounce + SpeakerTurnRow React.memo) on meeting 0c1a8987 (12 turns, 2 speakers). All target behaviors verified functionally identical to pre-refactor. No behavior regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: arePropsEqual accesses prev.pillStyle.backgroundColor / prev.rowStyle.backgroundColor / prev.pillStyle.color directly — if a caller ever passes undefined for pillStyle or rowStyle it would throw. Currently TranscriptTab always passes both, so safe today, but a defensive `prev.pillStyle?.backgroundColor === next.pillStyle?.backgroundColor` would be more robust.

The debounce is 200ms with a single-flight setTimeout+cleanup — correct. But there's a subtle edge: if the user opens Find & Replace and starts typing very fast, the first render of FindReplaceBar shows the counter based on debouncedFindQuery='' (empty) even though findQuery has content — for 200ms the counter shows nothing rather than a stale value. This is actually the desired behavior (no flash of wrong count) and matches acceptance criteria.

findMatchIdx reset useEffect (line 527) uses raw findQuery — not debouncedFindQuery. This is intentional & correct: as soon as query changes we reset to 0 so counter doesn't briefly show '5/2' during debounce window.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing meeting 0c1a8987-f2cc-478c-afe2-fe9e140ea7b1. All destructive tests (replace-all / replace-one / speaker reassign / flip-from-here / turn text edit) were followed by Discard so no persisted changes.
